purpose: Reconcile executable comparators with manuscript Section 3.3 before any paper-level SOTA claim.

paper_comparators.label: PI-GNN adapted
paper_comparators.preserved_mechanism: physics-informed graph message passing with model-based/coarse physical state features

paper_comparators.label: SF* adapted
paper_comparators.source: De la Varga et al., Electric Power Systems Research 241 (2025) 111268
paper_comparators.preserved_mechanism: linear state forecasting augmented by features induced by an underdetermined physical estimate

paper_comparators.label: PM* adapted
paper_comparators.source: De la Varga et al., Electric Power Systems Research 241 (2025) 111268
paper_comparators.preserved_mechanism: linear prediction of unavailable measurements/pseudo-measurements followed by physical state estimation

paper_comparators.label: PM-DSE adapted
paper_comparators.source: de Jongh et al., IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid 16(5) (2025) 3638-3652
paper_comparators.preserved_mechanism: historical time-series disaggregation to pseudo-measurements followed by physical state estimation

common_task.input: target monthly coarse statistics + fixed topology/parameters + target-external history only
common_task.output_stage_1: candidate temporal fine-grained prior/state representation, not monthly y
common_task.output_stage_2: common projection into the identical monthly-statistics and DC-network feasible set
common_task.postprocessing: identical nodal CEF -> fixed Area aggregation -> monthly responsibility

calibration_policy.allowed: synthetic/history windows outside formal target; hidden-state labels may be generated only inside calibration data
calibration_policy.formal_reference_use: one-time offline evaluation after method and hyperparameter lock

shared_candidate_representation.normalization: Area load / frozen Area base load; dispatch output / unit pmax
shared_candidate_representation.reason: retain network-location differences needed by state-estimation baselines; category-only representation failed the oracle-state projection self-check
shared_candidate_representation.calendar: 168 weekday-hour representatives expanded to February 2020 by frozen occurrence mapping

fairness.random_methods_report: 10 paired seeds; deterministic linear/disaggregation methods report one deterministic run unless stochastic fitting is introduced

paper_admissibility_gate: candidate-state rather than direct-y output path is verified
formal target hidden-state leakage test passes
common projection and CEF postprocessing are byte-identical across comparators
hyperparameters are frozen before Reference-only evaluation

common_projection.monthly_occurrence_weighting: February 2020 weekday-hour counts, 4 or 5 occurrences per representative slot
common_projection.candidate_objective: capacity-normalized L1 distance to candidate Area-load and unit-generation profiles
common_projection.postprocessing: identical nodal CEF -> fixed Area aggregation

selection_policy.metric: dimensionless hidden-state profile MAE over all 168x48 channels, including zero-output unit channels
selection_policy.post_lock_projection_smoke: calibration validation scenario only; does not alter selected hyperparameters
selection_policy.hidden_activity_mask: FORBIDDEN: state_active is a calibration label only and is not supplied to validation prediction, clipping, metric masking, formal training, or formal inference.

formal_evaluation_rule.phase_A: after pretarget lock verification, attach target_input_only.npz only; train/refit on all 120 calibration samples and freeze all candidate states and projected monthly predictions without loading reference_only.npz
formal_evaluation_rule.phase_B: only after blind predictions are frozen and hashed, attach reference_only.npz once for offline MAE/RMSE/MaxAE evaluation
